rules.text: The renderer's swapchain is created from the SDL window and is recreated after SDL_EVENT_WINDOW_PIXEL_SIZE_CHANGED before the next frame is presented.

probes.check: am_probe_acme_sdl3_surface(): resizes the window with SDL_SetWindowSize, runs two frames, and checks the swapchain extent matches SDL_GetWindowSizeInPixels.
probes.seeded_violation: Drop the swapchain recreation from the pixel-size-changed handler.

adaptation_notes: Acme's engine already had this glue in engine/platform/window.cpp; the agent adapted it in place rather than copying this file.
